dialogues.speaker: Mansur
dialogues.text: I'm a researcher from the Akademiya's Amu{RUBY#[S]Biology}rta, I came to the blacksmith's because I'm being oppre— uh, I mean, I'm doing some research for a paper I'm writing on air pollution.

dialogues.speaker: Mansur
dialogues.text: Anyway, I never imagined that I would develop such an interest in ironworking after having a look at it, and I unwittingly became Mr. Ahangar's apprentice...

dialogues.speaker: Mansur
dialogues.text: It seems a little too late to back out now. Mr. Ahangar adopted a lot of kids, but they all either became researchers or joined the Eremites.

dialogues.speaker: Mansur
dialogues.text: And yet somehow, a researcher like me who worries over their dissertation all day has now become the only heir to his craft...

dialogues.speaker: Mansur
dialogues.text: Still, I'm telling you, ironworking is a heck of a lot more fun than writing papers. Not only has my stamina improved, my hair's even stopped falling out.
